chapter: Changing styles, the road and nightlife
title: Lloyd Price's rough big band
summary: Both liked a 1960s singer who carried a raw, swinging 13-piece band like the original Basie group.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: I'm trying to think of this blues singer. His last name is Price.
Jesse Price was a drummer.
No, not Jesse Price. This was a singer. But, anyway, I --
Not Sammy Price.
No, no, this is in the '60s. [Lloyd Price]
Uh-huh.
And he carried a big band with him.
Oh, you're talking about -- yeah, right, 'Personality' was his song.
Yeah, yeah, and good singer, but he carried this big band with him, maybe 13 --
Right, right, he had a big band.
Rough, strong, --
Right, right.
It was like I would imagine the original Basie band was like.
Right, right, right, right, right, right, right, it was, it was. Just like the way they dressed, that's the way they played.
And swing.
Right, right, right.
Nothing fancy.
No, no.
God, that -- I miss a lot of that, when we get into homogenized --
Right, right, right, right, right.
